From the moment Liber enrolled mad poets among the Satyrs and Fauns, the sweet Muses have commonly smelt of wine in the morning. By his praises of wine, Homer is convicted of being wine-soaked; Father Ennius himself never sprang forth to tell of arms unless he had been drinking. "The Forum and Libo's Well I shall consign to the sober; I forbid the grave to sing": no sooner had I proclaimed this than the poets did not cease to compete in wine by night, to reek of it by day. What? If a man, fierce of face and bare of foot, and aping a scanty toga's weave, should counterfeit Cato, would he reproduce the virtue and the morals of Cato? The tongue of Iarbitas, rivalling Timagenes', burst him, while he strove to be thought witty and eloquent in the city's way. A model deceives by faults that can be copied: so if by chance I were pale, they would drink bloodless cumin. O imitators, you slavish herd, how often your stir has roused my anger, how often my laughter! I was the first to set free footsteps over open ground, treading where no one had gone; I did not press another's track. He who trusts himself will lead the swarm as its chief. I first showed Parian iambs to Latium, following the measures and the spirit of Archilochus, not his matter and the words that drove Lycambes. And, that you may not garland me with sparer leaves for this, because I feared to change the measures and the art of his song: manly Sappho tempers Archilochus' Muse with her foot, Alcaeus tempers it, but differs in matter and arrangement; he seeks no father-in-law to smear with black verses, nor weaves a noose for a bride with a defaming song. This poet, spoken by no other mouth before, I, the Latin lyrist, made known. It pleases me, bringing things unrecorded, to be read by noble eyes and held in noble hands. Would you know why the ungrateful reader praises and loves my little works at home, but unfairly belittles them out of doors? I do not hunt the votes of the fickle crowd with the cost of dinners and the gift of cast-off clothing; I, a hearer and champion of noble writers, do not deign to court the schoolmasters' tribes and their platforms. Hence those tears. "I am ashamed to recite to crowded theatres writings unworthy of them, and to give weight to trifles," if I have said this, "you laugh," he says, "and keep these things for Jove's ears: for you trust that you alone distil poetic honey, fair in your own eyes." At this I am afraid to turn up my nose, and, lest I be cut by his sharp nail as we wrestle, I cry "I dislike this place," and call for an adjournment; for sport breeds anxious rivalry and anger, anger fierce enmities and deadly war.

You seem, my book, to be eyeing Vertumnus and Janus, that you may stand for sale, neatly smoothed with the Sosii's pumice. You hate the keys and seals that the modest love; you groan at being shown to few, and praise the public view, though not so reared. Off, then, where you itch to go down. There will be no return for you, once sent forth. "What have I done, wretch? What did I want?" you will say, when someone has hurt you, and you know you are folded up tight, when the sated lover grows slack. But if the seer does not lose his wits through loathing of the sinner, you will be dear at Rome, until your youth forsakes you; when, thumbed by the hands of the crowd, you have begun to grow soiled, either you will silently feed the slothful bookworms, or run off to Utica, or be sent bound to Ilerda. The adviser, unheard, will laugh, like the man who in anger pushed his balky ass over the cliff: for who would labour to save one against his will? This too awaits you: that, while you teach boys their letters, stammering old age will overtake you in the outlying lanes. When the warmer sun has brought you more ears, you will tell that I, born of a freedman father and in slender means, spread wings too large for my nest, so that what you take from my birth you may add to my worth; that I pleased the foremost men of the city in war and peace, small of body, prematurely grey, fond of the sun, quick to anger, yet such that I could be appeased. If by chance anyone shall ask you about my age, let him know that I had completed eleven times four Decembers in the year that Lollius brought Lepidus to be his colleague.
